createStore.question: How do I open a store?
createStore.answer: Go to My stores and choose Create store. Creating an account and a store is free. Each store has its own products, website, shipping and payment settings.

fees.question: What does Tallaby charge?
fees.answerUsd: On the Free plan, {fee} per new order, taken from your store wallet when the order is placed. An order that looks like a test or a duplicate (same customer and same products within 2 hours) is charged only if it is delivered. The Pro plan is {pro} a month with no order fee. See Plan & usage.
fees.answer: A flat EGP 5 per new order, taken from your store wallet when the order is placed. An order that looks like a test or a duplicate (same customer and same products within 2 hours) is charged only if it is delivered. New sellers get EGP 100 in their wallet when they finish their store (choose a template, add a product and publish), valid for 30 days.

plan.question: How many stores can I have?
plan.answer: The Free plan includes up to 3 stores. You can see how many you're using in Plan & usage. If you need more, contact us.

addProduct.question: How do I add a product?
addProduct.answer: Open Add products, enter the name, price, stock and photos, then save. Products go live on your store right away, with no review step.

categories.question: Can I use my own categories?
categories.answer: Yes. Products › Categories holds your own list, and it comes first when you pick a product's category. Choose which products each store shows in Store settings › General.

manageOrders.question: Where do I see and follow up on orders?
manageOrders.answer: Orders lists every order across your stores. Open one to see the customer, items, payment and status. Delivery tracking follows each shipment until it reaches the customer.

delivery.question: Who delivers my orders?
delivery.answer: You do. Tallaby doesn't deliver orders. Use your own riders or your own shipping company (you can connect your Bosta account from Apps & integrations), and set your store's shipping areas and rates in Shipping settings.

fulfillment.question: Can Tallaby store, pack or handle returns for me?
fulfillment.answer: Yes. Request it from Fulfillment setup and choose what you want Tallaby to handle. Our team will contact you to agree the details before anything changes on your orders.

wallet.question: How does the store wallet work?
wallet.answer: Order fees are taken from your wallet, and every entry is listed in Balance & top-ups. The order amount itself is never added to the wallet: the customer pays you directly. The balance can go below zero; when it does, you'll see a reminder to top up.

topUp.question: How do I top up my wallet?
topUp.answerUsd: Open Balance & top-ups and choose Top up. Pick an amount from {min} to {max}; you see the total in EGP before you pay. Send it by Vodafone Cash or InstaPay and upload the transfer receipt. Your balance is credited once our team confirms the transfer. Card top-ups are coming soon.
topUp.answer: Open Balance & top-ups and choose Top up. Send between EGP 100 and EGP 20,000 by Vodafone Cash or InstaPay, then upload the transfer receipt. Your balance updates once our team confirms the transfer.

paymentMethods.question: Which payment methods can my store offer?
paymentMethods.answer: Cash on delivery is on for every store. In Payment methods you can also save your Vodafone Cash, e& Cash, WE Pay, Orange Cash or InstaPay details, or connect your own Paymob or Kashier account to take card payments. Fawry and installments are coming soon.

builder.question: How do I design my store's website?
builder.answer: Open Website builder. Every new store starts with the Tallaby Classic template; edit its sections, colours and text, then press Publish. Visitors only see your changes after you publish.

domain.question: Can I use my own domain?
domain.answer: Yes. Connect it in Online Store › Domain. Until then, your store works on its free Tallaby address.

seo.question: How do I show up better on Google?
seo.answer: Open Online Store › SEO. Each field shows the default your store already uses. Add your own title, description and keywords for the store and each page, or let AI write them for 1 credit.
